scope: A purposive sample of nine million-view YouTube explainer/animation Shorts across four channels; not an exhaustive ranking or causal experiment.
method: Exact public view totals from player metadata, eight timed browser-rendered stills per video, English automatic captions. No video/audio files downloaded; no source-audio listening audit. Exact keyframe easing, production software, private retention and swipe metrics were not observed.
